caption:
An unplanned relocation puts pressure on both time and cash simultaneously, but rushing the finance decision doesn't have to mean rushing the whole move — fast-turnaround finance can fund the essential fit-out and moving costs while you settle into the new space properly.

Prioritising what's essential for day one, versus what can follow later, helps keep the budget under control.
